propositions: The rate-limit sweep's file list is hardcoded to four transport modules rather than derived via glob, creating drift risk when a mutating method is renamed or moved to an unswept sibling module without assertion catching it.
An anti-drift guard must reject any classified mutating name outside the swept modules unless its body is a pure same-name self.transport delegation with arguments forwarded unchanged.

Current scope measurement finds exactly two collisions in backend.py (set_relationship and add_comment), both known-benign delegations; an anti-drift assertion should remain green against these while failing on any new or moved unswept definition using a classified mutating name unless it matches the pure-facade shape.

The sweep's subject must remain scoped to the transport layer (per ticket 8a5e ruling), not widened to the entire Jira package via glob, even though that would be drift-proof by construction but would demand individual 429-policy classification of 90 unrelated members.
